text.lead: Penance is a 2009 American horror film directed by Jake Kennedy. It stars Jason Connery, Marieh Delfino, Graham McTavish, and Michael Rooker. Horror film icon Tony Todd has a cameo role as a sinister chauffeur.
text.plot: A young mother decides to become a stripper to earn some fast cash only to find her worst nightmares are about to begin when she falls into the hands of a religious fanatic intent on changing her "evil" ways.
text.cast:
- Marieh Delfino as Amelia
- Graham McTavish as Geeves
- Jason Connery as John
- Valorie Hubbard as Kathy
- Lochlyn Munro as Jack
- Allison Lange as Tara
- Michael Rooker as Mann
- Tony Todd as Chauffeur
- James Duval as Guy
text.release: On November 17, 2009, an unrated Director's Cut was released on DVD by Independent Media Distribution. It was later released by Allegro Corporation on October 22, 2013.
text.reception: Nicolas Rapold for The New York Times was generally positive in his review. However, Mike D'Angelo for The Dissolve was less positive, saying the film was "painfully repetitive and monotonous".
